note: Curated persistent campaigns that do not show up cleanly as malware-family IOCs. Live botnet/malware rows are merged from ThreatFox, Feodo Tracker, and URLhaus at runtime.

campaigns.name: Salt Typhoon carrier tap
campaigns.summary: Long-dwell compromise of telecom/ISP edge devices and lawful-intercept systems. Packet capture + GRE egress.

campaigns.name: Flax Typhoon SOHO botnet
campaigns.summary: Integrity Technology Group-linked botnet of routers, NVRs and IoT used as stealth relays for PRC espionage.

campaigns.name: Volt Typhoon LOTL pre-position
campaigns.summary: PRC actor (G1017) living off the land inside U.S. critical infrastructure — Guam and mainland — for possible disruption, not theft.

campaigns.name: Silk Typhoon / Hafnium cloud identity
campaigns.summary: Exchange-era cluster now tracked as Silk Typhoon (G0125). Continues to hunt Microsoft 365 / identity-adjacent targets.

campaigns.name: Lazarus crypto + supply chain
campaigns.summary: Bybit ~$1.5B via Safe{Wallet} developer compromise; 2026 BlueNoroff Axios npm maintainer RAT.

campaigns.name: Sandworm ZEROLOT wipers
campaigns.summary: Destructive wipers against Ukrainian energy; attempted similar hit on Polish energy systems.

campaigns.name: Pawn Storm Office 0-day
campaigns.summary: Trend Micro H1 2026: APT28 weaponized a fresh Office zero-day against war-related defense and border-police targets.

campaigns.name: APT42 SpearSpecter
campaigns.summary: TAMECAT against Gulf defense officials via WhatsApp, including family-member targeting. Tempo up in 2026.

campaigns.name: Scattered Spider identity raids
campaigns.summary: Native-English help-desk vishing, Okta/Entra federation hijack, then ransomware (DragonForce). Retail, airlines, insurance.

campaigns.name: Cl0p mass MFT / ERP extortion
campaigns.summary: Encryption-optional data theft via file-transfer and ERP zero-days (Cleo, MOVEit, Oracle EBS). Hundreds of victims per burst.

campaigns.name: Akira RaaS
campaigns.summary: Top-tier RaaS. Edge-VPN initial access, ESXi encryption, ~$244M reported proceeds and 600+ victims through late 2025.

campaigns.name: Qilin (Agenda) RaaS
campaigns.summary: Most active ransomware brand in Q3 2025 after RansomHub collapsed. MSP cascade + Rust intermittent encryptor.
